forbidden.name: agent-graph-api-not-stores
forbidden.comment: A remote agent op reaches the graph through the LGraph/LGraphNode API that humans and extensions use, never by writing the node or link stores directly. The stores are value holders; the graph API is the one place that owns link validation, widget callbacks and undo tracking, so writing them first means every one of those has to be re-derived afterwards. That re-derivation was the reconciliation layer the FE-2504 rewrite deleted (#18700), and this rule is what stops it growing back. See docs/adr/CRDT-FOLLOWER-0025-in-app-agent-crdt-follower-and-distribution-resolved-boundaries.md, 'The follower writes the graph API, not the stores'. widgetValueStore is deliberately not listed: docOpMinter.ts and widgetValuesForm.ts read it to mint and project, which is not a store-first apply.
